clue.text: Deliver one rebuke after start of, lesson

indicators.note: after says the I and the rebuke come behind the opening letter
the start of the word lesson is its opening letter

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
to rebuke is to berate

explanation.surface: A teacher scolds someone right at the beginning of a lesson.
explanation.walkthrough: The comma after 'of' is a printing quirk; read 'start of lesson' together.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver someone is to set them free, a synonym.

clue.text: Deserted the side? That's not right

definitions.meaning: deserted means went away from, abandoned
the side that is not the right one is the other, port side

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has gone away has departed; and the opposite of the right side is its partner on the other hand.

clue.text: Knock bishop down

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
feeling down is feeling low

explanation.surface: A bishop is knocked down.
explanation.definitionFit: A knock and a blow are both strikes, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Surgical instrument found in rubbish Egyptologist turned over

indicators.note: turned over says the whole run of rubbish and Egyptologist is read backwards

parts.note: rot is rubbish, nonsense
Howard Carter was the Egyptologist who found Tutankhamun's tomb

explanation.surface: A surgeon's tool turns up in the junk an archaeologist was sorting through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' reverses ROT + CARTER as one run, giving RETRAC + TOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgeon uses this instrument to hold the edges of a wound apart.

clue.text: Value pursuit that requires clues to be solved

definitions.text: Value pursuit that requires clues to be solved

parts.note: to value something is to treasure it
a hunt is a pursuit

explanation.surface: A chase in which each clue must be cracked to reach the prize.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes the game, while 'Value' and 'pursuit' build it piece by piece.
explanation.definitionFit: This game sends players following a chain of riddles towards a hidden prize.

clue.text: Assembled picture of national leader

definitions.meaning: a picture put together from small tiles or pieces
relating to Moses, who led the Israelites out of Egypt

explanation.definitionFit: Tiled artwork is made of many pieces fitted together; and the Law of Moses is the Mosaic law.

clue.text: Outstanding squadrons circle overhead

indicators.note: in a down answer, overhead puts the circle on top of the squadrons

parts.note: a circle is shaped like the letter O
a wing is an air-force unit made up of several squadrons

explanation.surface: Unpaid squadrons fly round in a loop above.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill that is outstanding has not yet been paid.

clue.text: A lot of correspondence, none overdue, in Peter's office

parts.note: the post is a batch of mail
O is zero, none
late means overdue

explanation.surface: Saint Peter's office is buried under letters, none of them late.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter was an apostle, and the position or mission of an apostle has its own name.

clue.text: Deny girl has entered into formal agreement

indicators.note: has entered into says the girl's name goes inside the agreement

parts.note: a contract is a formal agreement
Di is a girl's name, short for Diana

explanation.surface: Someone denies that a young woman has signed up to a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: To deny a statement is to gainsay it, the same sense.

clue.text: Father, on the level, marches

definitions.note: marches are border lands, a plural noun for a singular answer, as the border country is one region

parts.note: Fr is short for Father, as a priest's title
taken as written
a tier is a level or layer

explanation.surface: A father walks on flat ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'marches' looks like a verb, but it is the old noun for borderlands, such as the Welsh Marches.
explanation.definitionFit: The marches are the border districts between two countries.

clue.text: Hot wind is coming back a month later

indicators.note: later puts the month after the reversed word
coming back says the word is reads backwards

parts.note: a moon is a lunar month

explanation.surface: A hot wind returns a month on.
explanation.definitionFit: The simoon is a hot, dry, dusty desert wind in Arabia and North Africa.

clue.text: Bureaucrat has to abandon bad diamonds

parts.note: to jack in is to give up, abandon
food that is off has gone bad
ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: An official has to walk away from some fake jewels.
explanation.walkthrough: JACK IN is British slang for quitting something.
explanation.definitionFit: A jack-in-office is a petty official who makes the most of a little authority.

clue.text: This is killing, as evidenced by guy's mirth

parts.note: a guy is a man, so guy's is man's
laughter is mirth

explanation.surface: A man's laughter is so funny it is killing.
explanation.definitionFit: This crime is an unlawful killing without intent to murder.

clue.text: Her work, under cover, keeps corporations under control

definitions.text: Her work, under cover, keeps corporations under control

parts.words: Her work, under cover, keeps corporations under control
parts.note: corporations here are big bellies, kept in check by a garment worn under clothes, made by a woman

explanation.definitionFit: A woman who makes and fits corsets, the undergarments that hold a paunch in.

clue.text: Chemical processes I'm most able to alter

indicators.note: to alter says these words are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of being best able to change chemical processes.
explanation.definitionFit: The body's chemical reactions that turn food into energy go by this name.

clue.text: Finished ahead of time-that's evident

indicators.note: ahead of puts the word for finished in front of the time

parts.note: something over is finished

explanation.surface: Finishing early is plain to see.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means open and not hidden, so plain to see.

clue.text: Excited again about class, went ahead

parts.note: re means about, concerning
a kind is a class or type
led means went in front

explanation.surface: A class was stirred up again by someone going in front.
explanation.definitionFit: To stir up feelings once more is to fire them a second time, like relighting a fire.

clue.text: Book's observation about dance, mostly

indicators.note: about says the observation goes around the shortened dance

parts.note: a note is a remark, an observation

indicators.note: mostly says the dance loses its last letter

parts.note: the veleta is an old-time ballroom dance

explanation.surface: A book offers comments on a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the dance's last letter and 'about' wraps the observation round what is left; the veleta is an old British ballroom dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A novelette is a short novel, a kind of book.

clue.text: During exploration you reported one new marine creature

indicators.note: During says the sounded letter sits inside the exploration

parts.note: a search is an exploration

indicators.note: reported says the word you is taken by its sound, as a single letter

parts.note: you sounds like the letter U
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: An undersea explorer reports finding a new sea creature.
explanation.definitionFit: This spiny animal of the seabed is a marine invertebrate.

clue.text: In charge on vessel, seeing clearly ahead

indicators.note: in an across answer, on means placed after the vessel

parts.note: a vat is a large vessel

explanation.surface: Someone in charge aboard a ship has a clear view ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Vatic means prophetic, foreseeing what is to come.

clue.text: Found lots had moved many times over

indicators.note: moved says these words are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: It turned out lots had been relocated over and over.
explanation.definitionFit: Multiplied by a thousand, so increased many times.

clue.text: He wrote at great speed

explanation.definitionFit: The Irish satirist was a writer; and swift means fast.

clue.text: Spread, say, and dry

indicators.note: say tells us the word for spread is taken by its sound

parts.note: to bruit a rumour is to spread it

explanation.surface: A spread is dry.
explanation.definitionFit: Brut describes very dry champagne or sparkling wine.

clue.text: Take ship from Genoa, say

definitions.meaning: a genoa is a large jib ..., an example of this kind of canvas

explanation.definitionFit: To set off on a voyage is to go to sea; a genoa is a large foresail on a yacht.

clue.text: Team involved in upset reverts to underlying principle

indicators.note: involved in says the team goes inside the reversed word
reverts says the word for upset is read backwards

parts.note: to rile is to upset
XI is eleven, a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: A team, thrown into disarray, goes back to basics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reverts' looks like part of the definition, but it turns the word for upset backwards, giving ELIR, and the team sits inside that.
explanation.definitionFit: An elixir once meant the quintessence or essential principle of a thing.

clue.text: Climber long ago knew song

parts.note: wist is an old word for knew
an aria is an operatic song

explanation.surface: A mountaineer of old knew a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: Wistaria, also spelt wisteria, is a climbing plant.

clue.text: Strife in university in Eastern city in US

indicators.note: this in says the university sits inside the city

parts.note: NY is New York, a US city
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: There is unrest at a university in an East Coast American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Enmity is hostility, a state of strife between parties.

clue.text: Some characters inside impede stalwart supporter

indicators.note: some characters inside says the letters are found within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Something gets in the way of a loyal backer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedestal is a base that holds up a statue or column.
